# Architecture Spine — checklist

- [ ] Is the title present with a scope line?
- [ ] Is there exactly one container view, with proposed and in-flight-class elements marked and no removed element drawn?
- [ ] Is every element one row with an id, a kind, a responsibility and a status — Raised and Weighed filled only on a build-raised element, a removed element reduced to id, kind, name and status?
- [ ] Does each diagram earn its place, or does the container view already say it?
- [ ] Is each note one line, keyed to an element id?
